label: Glory domes people travel to and are healed in
description: Dome structures seen filled with glory, to which people travel for miles from the east and west coasts, walking in and being healed, delivered and saved, as part of a great revival running across America, Europe and Africa.
aliases: healed by the power of God

label: America's seventy-year blessing ran out in 2015
description: Reasoning from the seventieth anniversary of the Second World War victory that a special seventy-year blessing on America ended in 2015, presented as part of a pattern of grace periods God has given the nation and as a warning that the current one is running down.
